endorsements.name: Moniruzzaman Prodhan
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-15513
endorsements.description: The Float Payment Gateway plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized modification of data due to improper error handling in the verifyFloatResponse() function in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.9. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to mark any WooCommerce order as failed.

endorsements.label: CVE-2025-15565
endorsements.description: The Nexi XPay plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized modification of data due to missing authorization checks on the redirect function in all versions up to, and including, 8.3.0.
